description: Average the season-to-date points of driver standings records whose points are strictly greater than 1.0, leaving out records at exactly 1.0.

a.request: Looking only at driver standings records whose season-to-date championship points total (`driverStandings.points`) is more than 1.0, what is the single overall average of that points total across those records (ignoring missing values, unrounded)?
a.sql: SELECT AVG(points) AS average_points FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0

b.request: Calculate the unrounded average of nonmissing `driverStandings.points` values strictly greater than 1.0 across all driver standings records.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points IS NOT NULL AND points > 1.0;
b.raw: Calculate the unrounded average of nonmissing `driverStandings.points` values strictly greater than 1.0 across all driver standings records.

d.request: Compute the unrounded average of non-null `driverStandings.points` across all driver standings records where `driverStandings.points > 1.0`.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points IS NOT NULL AND points > 1.0;

c.request: Split driver standings records by their season-to-date championship points total (`driverStandings.points`), using 1.0 points as the dividing line, and keep only the records on the higher side. What is the single overall average of that points total across the kept records (ignoring missing values, unrounded)? Average the season-to-date points of driver standings records whose points are strictly greater than 1.0, leaving out records at exactly 1.0.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0;
